mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when UNRATE > 4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between joint HOUST/RSAFS decline and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or average 60-day return under condition is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 reduces economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO < 100 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 150,000) increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when PAYEMS > 150,000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) prompts restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ decline) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when GDPC1 QoQ decline are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 1500) combined with high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) creates dual headwinds for consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between joint HOUST/FEDFUNDS condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or average 20-day return under condition is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
